workflows.summary: Resolve an Atomical and inspect its current ownership
workflows.description: Resolve a Realm or NFT identifier and fetch the asset, its holders, and its history.

steps.typescript:
const response = await client.get_asset(/* parameters per atomicals-nfts-realms contract */)
assert(response.ok)
steps.javascript:
const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3043/v1/atomicals/assets/{atomicalId}', { headers: { accept: 'application/json' } })
if (!response.ok) throw new Error('step fetch-asset failed')

steps.typescript:
const response = await client.get_asset_holders(/* parameters per atomicals-nfts-realms contract */)
assert(response.ok)
steps.javascript:
const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3043/v1/atomicals/assets/{atomicalId}/holders', { headers: { accept: 'application/json' } })
if (!response.ok) throw new Error('step fetch-holders failed')

workflows.summary: Build and validate a safe ARC-20 transfer plan locally
workflows.description: Entirely local. Uses the UTXO Safety Planner to generate candidate plans and the Protocol Lab to replay the winning plan before anything is signed. No OpenAPI call moves funds.

steps.typescript:
const response = await client.get_by_outpoint(/* parameters per atomicals-nfts-realms contract */)
assert(response.ok)
steps.javascript:
const response = await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:3043/v1/atomicals/utxos/{txid}/{vout}', { headers: { accept: 'application/json' } })
if (!response.ok) throw new Error('step plan-locally failed')
